messages:
maria: heads-up — spotting a steady rise in 5xxs and p95 in eu-west after the 2.1.4 canary. putting tonight's 23:00 UTC release on hold.
ryan: ack. is this the same routing hiccup from earlier or a new regression?
maria: looks like a regression tied to kernel path in the inference runtime. spikes align with long-sequence requests. canary at 10% effected.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @maria (2601239876) — STATUS: HOLD — reason: Incident INC-4201 detected during canary.
elaine: can we pin prod back to 2.1.3 quickly? need to confirm migrations are backward-compatible.
matt: confirmed: 2.1.3 <-> 2.1.4 uses backward-safe DB schema. rolling back to 2.1.3 is safe for config and runtime.
sophia: +1 to pin and reschedule the window. we'll need updated release notes and a comms blurb for support.
maria: plan proposal: 1) activate pin to 2.1.3 in prod 2) annotate release notes + customer comms 3) reschedule 2.1.4 for Tue 02:00 UTC after incident clears.
ryan: sounds good. do we want a canary tweak (smaller traffic slice) before full re-run?
matt: yes — set canary to 3% with extended monitoring for the first 30m. also disable auto-rollforward.
maria: execute steps now.
deploy-bot: Command queued by @maria: rollback-activate --version 2.1.3 --scope prod --reason "INC-4201 regressions"
oncall-bot: Incident INC-4201 status: INVESTIGATING — eu-west edge nodes reporting increased CPU/latency under long-sequence workloads.
elaine: support status: drafting customer notice. will post to #support-internal for review.
sophia: I'm updating the calendar change window and adding a reschedule entry. proposed new window: Tue 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC.
maria: anyone object to Tue 02:00 UTC? tightest slot to avoid APAC business hours.
ryan: fine from my side.
matt: fine. add a canary flag so it doesn't auto-promote.
sophia: I'll create the release-notes PR and link it here.
maria: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/437 — includes rollback rationale and incident note. :clipboard:
maria: deploy-bot returned: rollback-activate completed by @maria — prod pinned to 2.1.3.
sophia: calendar updated, support comms queued.
rayan: (typo) — ignore
maria: minor follow-up: add an eval run for the sequence-length distribution before reschedule. we'll run a small A/B test against 2.1.4 branch once incident is fully cleared.
matt: note for release docs: call out the kernel fallback change that was introduced in 2.1.4.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-4201 update: mitigation in progress — decreasing error rate observed in probe nodes.
maria: thanks all — moving this to follow-up. I'll close this thread once the reschedule is formally accepted and the postmortem stub is live. :white_check_mark:
